items.title: Nvidia board rejects Jensen Huang's offer to return as CEO, says no plan to reinstate him
items.description: "The Nvidia board unanimously accepted his resignation and does not intend to reinstate Jensen as CEO," Chairman Harvey Jones said during an earnings call on Tuesday.

items.title: Centricity WealthTech launches private clients business for NRIs
items.description: Centricity is targeting approximately Rs 60 crore revenue from its NRI business in 2027-28, with revenue projected to reach around four times that level by the third year

items.title: L&T targets Zorawar tank production by 2029, submits competitive bid for AMCA programme
items.description: The defence major is awaiting the outcome of its fighter aircraft bid while preparing its indigenous light tank for military trials and pursuing overseas orders for homegrown weapon systems

items.title: From Zorawar to drones, Indian defence firms push indigenous systems, exports
items.description: Indian defence companies are scaling indigenous platforms, drone production and space technologies while seeking wider export opportunities and closer industry-government collaboration

items.title: Tata Sons told RBI it intended to fully comply with regulations in October 6 letter
items.description: Group holding company sought guidance from the RBI on how to comply with the applicable regulations due to ambiguity about the timeline for listing, according to people familiar with the matter

items.title: Kissht's lending arm Si Creva gets rating upgrade to 'IND A/Stable'
items.description: The rating upgrade reflects improvement in the company's profitability, disciplined lending practices and stronger capital position, according to a statement.

items.title: NMDC targets 100 million tonnes of iron ore output, eyes pellet capacity expansion
items.description: The company had said last year that it was exploring acquisition opportunities in critical minerals across Africa, Australia and South America as part of its global mineral diversification strategy

items.title: Signature Global-led consortium wins 475-acre land parcel in MMR for Rs 194 crore via PACL auction
items.description: Gurugram-based developer enters Maharashtra’s real estate market with land parcels spread across Raigad district, near the Navi Mumbai International Airport; company yet to finalise development plans

items.title: Muthoot Finance shelves Belstar Microfinance IPO, not keen to list now, says executive vice chair George Alexander Muthoot
items.description: Muthoot expects more gold loan auctions as borrowers adjust to monthly interest payments

items.title: India's electronics exports jump 44% to $32 billion in April-September, non-smartphone shipments lead growth
items.description: Smartphone exports increased to $18.17 billion from $13.38 billion a year ago. However, their share in total electronic goods exports declined to 56.8% from 60.3%, as other electronics categories gained ground.

items.title: Amazon plans $7 billion renewable energy investment in India by 2030; unveils 4 projects of 934 MW
items.description: The company's portfolio in India comprises a total of 57 projects, including 14 utility-scale wind and solar projects that add carbon-free energy to the grid and 43 on-site solar installations across its facilities.

items.title: Anil Agarwal warns ONGC’s takeover of Vedanta’s oilfield risks denting investor confidence
items.description: The remarks come against the backdrop of an ongoing legal dispute over the CB-OS-02 Cambay offshore block, where Vedanta held a 40 percent participating interest, ONGC 50 percent and Invenire Petrodyne the remaining 10 percent.

items.title: Millions launches US stocks, ETFs investment facility for Indian investors
items.description: The new offering allows investors to start with fractional investments in US-listed companies and build portfolios through systematic investment plans (SIPs) at daily, weekly or monthly intervals, Millions said in a statement.

items.title: Nvidia forms new board committee to oversee national security and chip export controls
items.description: Nvidia said the formation of the committee reflected the board's commitment to strengthening its engagement with relevant government stakeholders and maintaining high standards of corporate governance and oversight

items.title: Nvidia forms board committee to oversee national security, export controls amid Huang row
items.description: By some estimates, Nvidia has more than half a trillion dollars of commitments in the form of various supply and capacity backstops for chip purchases, data center leases and equity investments

items.title: Less than 20% of India's gold market tapped, says Muthoot Finance's George Alexander Muthoot
items.description: Gold loan industry federation seeks to bring more unorganised lenders into the regulated NBFC fold as companies look to tap the largely underpenetrated market

items.title: OPINION | The three habits that keep a leader learning
items.description: The Bhagavad Gita offers three lessons for better leadership. Humility, sincere questions and service help leaders keep learning and build stronger teams

items.title: Indian smartphone brands need R&D, component ecosystem to compete globally: Industry leaders
items.description: India must move beyond assembly-led electronics manufacturing and invest in indigenous design, R&D, component manufacturing and IP creation to build global brands, industry leaders said at the Rising Bharat Summit

items.title: India targeting $25 billion electronics exports to China; total shipments to hit Rs 6 lakh crore: ICEA's Pankaj Mohindroo
items.description: India's overall electronics exports are expected to grow to last year's Rs 4.5 lakh crore, as it builds on the scale achieved in mobile phone manufacturing and expands its presence in global markets

items.title: V2 Retail: Can sharp correction offer an entry opportunity?
items.description: Weak SSSG and cash conversion temper expansion gains, despite improving margins and customer retention

items.title: Kaynes Technology: Growth engine intact, balance sheet under lens
items.description: Vishay deal and OSAT/PCB ramp-up are the next catalysts; working capital and operating cash flow make us cautious

items.title: From India's first email to its sovereign digital future: Rediff's Rs 600 crore second act
items.description: The first chapter of Rediff's story was about giving India a place on the internet. Its second may be about giving Indian businesses a greater sense of ownership over their digital future.

items.title: RBI tells Tata Sons to comply with listing requirement ahead of Nov 26 board meet
items.description: RBI's letter comes as Noel Tata seeks board discussion of a restructuring proposal aimed at keeping Tata Sons unlisted, alongside a Rs 25,000-crore liquidity proposal for the Shapoorji Pallonji Group.

items.title: Bain Capital-backed RSB Group raises funds from White Oak Capital, 360 ONE Asset, others
items.description: The current capital raise from 5 investors also includes an additional infusion from the Behera family

items.title: OPINION | The ‘Jensen premium’ and the fallout on Nvidia after its end
items.description: The past week has shown how much of the company's value rested on one person. Investors can now see that clearly, and it raises a question: is what they once paid for as the Jensen premium now a risk?
